source_name: CVR-permanent — Det Centrale Virksomhedsregister (base company data)
license: Free reuse incl. commercial under CVR-loven; honour reklamebeskyttelse (advertising-protection) flag
catalog_basis: Documented from analysis/denmark/schema_notes.md, source_inventory.json, and public CVR distribution documentation. NO raw records were downloaded for this source: a live match_all without credentials returned HTTP 401 (auth gate confirmed). Field meanings are well-known public CVR concepts; example_values shown are documented code/format illustrations, not observed records. Treat as planning-only until credentials are obtained.

fields.meaning: 8-digit CVR number — the primary national identifier for the company. Doubles as the base for the Danish VAT number ('DK' + cvrNummer).
fields.limitations: Numeric in source; pad/format as 8-digit string for joins. Examples are CVR numbers observed in the open offentliggoerelser source, not from this auth-gated index.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary join key across all CVR layers (offentliggoerelser, registreringstekster, produktionsenhed.virksomhedsrelation, deltager).

fields.meaning: Name history. Each entry has navn (the name) and periode.gyldigFra / periode.gyldigTil validity bounds. The current legal name is the entry whose gyldigTil is null.
fields.limitations: No raw sample observed (auth-gated). Must pick the current entry (gyldigTil == null) for display name.
fields.analysis_notes: Use current name as primary legal_name; retain prior names as previous_names.

fields.meaning: Legal form code with validity periods. Codes map to Danish company forms.
fields.limitations: Example codes are documented mappings, not observed records. Each entry carries periode validity; pick current.
fields.analysis_notes: Carry both code and accompanying text (langBeskrivelse) where present.

fields.meaning: Operational/legal status with validity periods (e.g. NORMAL, UNDER KONKURS, OPLØST, UNDER TVANGSOPLØSNING).
fields.limitations: No raw sample observed. A separate sammensatStatus / lifecycle may also indicate active vs ceased.
fields.analysis_notes: Pick the current status entry (gyldigTil == null) for the headline status.

fields.meaning: Registered/physical address with validity periods. Structured fields incl. street (vejnavn), house number, postal code (postnummer), town (postdistrikt), and municipality code (kommune.kommuneKode).
fields.limitations: No raw sample observed. Structured subfields documented from schema notes.
fields.analysis_notes: Pick current entry; expose municipality code separately for geography.

fields.meaning: Postal/mailing address when it differs from the registered address.
fields.limitations: Often absent when same as beliggenhedsadresse.

fields.meaning: Primary industry classification code (DB07, the Danish NACE Rev. 2 derivative), with branchetekst description and validity periods.
fields.limitations: No raw sample observed. 6-digit DB07 codes.
fields.analysis_notes: Map to NACE for cross-country activity mapping.

fields.meaning: Up to three secondary industry classifications (DB07), each with text and validity periods.
fields.analysis_notes: Collect non-null secondary codes into an activities array.

fields.meaning: Typed attribute list keyed by type. Includes registered capital (type KAPITAL, with currency), capital currency (REGISTRERET_KAPITAL_VALUTA), and company purpose (type FORMÅL). Each value carries validity periods.
fields.limitations: Heterogeneous; values are stored as strings with a type discriminator. Capital value/currency must be parsed.
fields.analysis_notes: Extract KAPITAL -> share_capital, FORMÅL -> purpose. Keep the rest as raw extension.

fields.meaning: Yearly employment figures: year (aar), employee count interval (antalAnsatte / intervalKodeAntalAnsatte), full-time equivalents, and employee bands.
fields.limitations: Bands/intervals, not always exact counts. May lag.

fields.meaning: Monthly employment figures (year/month, employee and FTE interval bands).
fields.analysis_notes: Use most recent month for current headcount band.

fields.meaning: Lifecycle/existence intervals (periode.gyldigFra/gyldigTil). An open-ended final period indicates the entity is still in existence; a closed final period indicates cessation.
fields.limitations: Use together with virksomhedsstatus to determine dissolution.
fields.analysis_notes: Derive dissolution_date from the close of the last lifecycle period when status is OPLØST.

fields.limitations: May be absent for very old or special entities.

fields.meaning: Relations to participants (deltagere): owners, management/board, and beneficial owners (reelle ejere). Each links a participant (person or legal entity) with an organisation/role and validity periods.
fields.limitations: Personal data — GDPR + address-protection rules apply. Full participant detail lives in the separate deltager index; this field carries the relation/role.
fields.analysis_notes: Resolve participant identity by joining to the deltager index; honour address protection.

fields.meaning: Contact details: email (elektroniskPost), phone (telefonNummer), website (hjemmeside), each typically with validity periods.
fields.limitations: May be reklamebeskyttet (advertising-protected); gate marketing use on the protection flag.
fields.analysis_notes: Pick current entry; carry advertising-protection flag through.

fields.meaning: Convenience rollup object provided by CVR summarising the newest values (e.g. nyesteNavn, nyesteVirksomhedsform, nyesteStatus, nyesteHovedbranche, sammensatStatus) so consumers need not resolve validity periods themselves.
fields.limitations: Derived/convenience view; verify against the period-bearing arrays when precision matters.
fields.analysis_notes: Best shortcut for current name/form/status/branche without period resolution.
